summary: Added three ECS rules: E3052 (Fargate task definitions require NetworkMode awsvpc), E3053 (Fargate task definitions cannot use privileged containers), and E3054 (ECS services with LaunchType FARGATE require NetworkConfiguration). Each is JSON-schema based with a schema file, a rule module under src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/, and unit tests. docs/rules.md has rows for all three. The 80 ECS and rules-collection tests pass. The full suite has 1536 passing and 5 failing, none caused by the new rules: test_formatters.py was excluded because defusedxml is missing from the shared venv; test_junit fails because src has no __main__.py; the two quickstart integration tests fail on a date-dependent E2533 Lambda runtime message; and test_build_graph needs pygraphviz or pydot. Nothing is committed. The spec did not name the three rules, so I chose these checks.
